quotes.text: Without a selected mailbox there is nothing to apply the rights to.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: An unsolicited IMAP MYRIGHTS response can arrive before selecting a mailbox. In that state there is no folder to update; consume the response and keep the connection usable instead of copying a null mailbox name.
title: Ignore MYRIGHTS when no IMAP mailbox is selected
